query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `payment_webhook_events` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `organizationId` INT NOT NULL,
  `eventType` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `payloadHash` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  `payload` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `linkedInvoiceId` INT,
  `linkedStudentId` INT,
  `status` ENUM('received', 'processed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL,
  `processedAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `errorMessage` TEXT,
  `receivedAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_payment_webhook_org` (`organizationId`),
  INDEX `idx_payment_webhook_event_type` (`eventType`),
  INDEX `idx_payment_webhook_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_payment_webhook_received` (`receivedAt`)
)
